observations.finding: Blue channel read from composite vs DMSO field f_9fbcadfb9d0d: nuclei appear larger on average in treated fields, most evident at 3.0 uM w_f6f242c435 f_25a42a6108a5/f_e05ab8ed76ff. Oval nuclei retained, contours smooth, no fragmentation. Nuclear diameter visibly increased, scattered enlarged bright nuclei. f_395bbe497a3f at 0.3 uM shows outlier giant cell lower-center with ~5 nuclei in common cytoplasm, classic cytokinesis failure. Mitotic figures with condensed chromosomes still present, not markedly increased.
Integrated DAPI intensity per nucleus increased: nuclei look not dimmer despite larger area, implying higher DNA content/G2-polyploidy. Consistent with enlarged nuclear area.
nuc_solidity and nuc_major_axis increase reported: nuclei remain regular/round-oval, slightly longer major axis, visibly smooth.

Green channel: tubulin network preserved in all treated fields. Interphase microtubule array radial, no loss, no strong bundling or depolymerization. No rosette monopolar spindles. Mitotic spindles still visible as bright green-yellow foci.

Red channel: cortical F-actin at cell periphery preserved. Cell boundaries distinct, no actin clumps, stress fiber collapse or contracted rounded cells. Texture appears similar to DMSO, maybe slightly smoother at 3.0 uM.
act_glcm_contrast z -2.749 at 3.0 uM indicates modestly more homogeneous actin texture. Visually subtle, not a clear disruption. act_mean z -1.42 not strong.
No tubulin-specific feature among top deviations, tub/act ratio unchanged, consistent with intact microtubules.

Cell size increased: cytoplasmic area larger vs DMSO, cells more spread. Measured cell_area z 6.19 4201 vs 3315 median and cell_major_axis z 3.86 99.4 vs 88.9 at 3.0 uM. Visible as larger polygonal cells, especially around enlarged nuclei.

Cell number per field reduced at 3.0 uM, trend at 0.3 uM. DMSO median 311.5, 3.0 uM 248 z -3.46 strong, 0.3 uM 270.5 z -2.23 borderline. Confluent monolayer still present but black cell-free gaps similar or slightly larger, compatible with growth inhibition without massive cell death.
Only composites given, no separate grayscale channels, so intensity judgments made from composite colour with identical contrast to DMSO per instruction.

notable_cells.why: Giant multinucleated cell with ~5 nuclei sharing enlarged green cytoplasm, direct evidence of failed cytokinesis/polyploidy. Not captured by median metrics but supports Aurora phenotype. No equivalent in DMSO.

candidate_mechanisms.why: Enlarged nuclei nuc_area z 7.44, increased cell_area z 6.19, increased integrated DNA z 3.89, reduced cell_count, preserved actin/tubulin, plus giant multinucleated cell at lower dose = cytokinesis failure/polyploidy typical of Aurora inhibition. No actin disruption, no microtubule depolymerization/stabilization, no Eg5 rosettes.

report.uncertainty: Moderate. Dose response clearest at 3.0 uM for nuclear/cell size and DNA content. Low dose top deviations weak |z|<2.5 but giant cell visually striking. Cannot exclude DNA damage/DNA replication causing G2 arrest and enlarged nuclei, but multinucleation favors Aurora kinase inhibitors over pure DNA damage. Microtubule destabilizers/stabilizers, Actin disruptors, Eg5 inhibitors inconsistent with preserved cytoskeleton. Therefore Aurora best fit, alternative unknown if strictly requiring stronger mitotic defect.
